title: Colours of the Rainbow | Fun Kids Song for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A bright, bouncy song about mixing paint colours to make a rainbow, with a silly puppy who turns the painting into a happy mess.
It teaches little ones the names of the colours and that sharing laughter makes every day brighter.
Fun, gentle and perfect for toddlers and preschoolers!

Red and orange, yellow too,
Mix the colours, look at you,
Jhum, jhum, jhum, jhum,
The rainbow shines!

Red, orange, yellow, green,
Blue and purple, rainbow seen,
Chuk, chuk, chuk, chuk,
A rainbow for everyone!

Puppy runs through paint pots, see,
Paw prints here and there, oh me!
Pat, pat, pat, pat,
Sister's frock has prints too!

Red, orange, yellow, green,
Blue and purple, rainbow seen,
Chuk, chuk, chuk, chuk,
A rainbow for everyone!

Sister giggles, brother grins,
Paw prints bloom like flowers, look!
Ha ha ha, ha ha ha,
Let's paint a paw-print tree!

Red, orange, yellow, green,
Blue and purple, rainbow seen,
Chuk, chuk, chuk, chuk,
A rainbow for everyone!

Puppy gets a bubble bath, splish splash,
Amma says, "What a sight!"
Bubbles, bubbles, pop, pop, pop,
Rainbow on the wall, goodnight!
